messages.subject: random question - not sure where to ask...
parts:
I use ggplot2 a LOT. In a personal project, I decided against ggplot2 and built my own graphs with text because (I suppose) text takes less time to load/update. Are there any R packages / projects out there for generating a range of plots (line / bar / polar / scatter) using only text characters?

... weird question - I think - but, maybe someone has a clue what I'm talking about.

Thanks,
Dan
